translations.translatedText: Italian celebrations. Helsinki Cup. Finns' savings. Motorcycle accident. Drownings. Weather.
The TV easy news has a summer break.
The radio easy news is made every day, also in summer.
## Italy wins the European Championship
![Italians at Manta.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12017957)
Open image viewer
Italians celebrate the European Championship win also around the Havis Amanda statue in Helsinki. Photo: Federico Ferrara.
The football European Championship has ended, and in Italy the win has been celebrated.
Italy is the new European champion in football. Italy won the European Championship final against England on Sunday.
The final match was exciting. When the playing time ended, the situation was level at 1–1. In the penalty shoot-out Italy was better and won the match.
After the win the Italian celebrations began. Italians also celebrated in Finland, for example at the Helsinki market square around the Havis Amanda statue.
## Helsinki Cup
![Kirsi Kavanne at Helsinki Cup.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_6240,h_3510,x_0,y_322/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-83094560ec02672d037/1626079940)
Open image viewer
Young football players and Helsinki Cup managing director Kirsi Kavanne. Photo: Matti Myller / Yle
The Helsinki Cup football tournament has started here in Finland. It lasts the whole week.
The Helsinki Cup is a football event for children and young people. This year over 1,400 teams and over 20,000 players are taking part.
There are also teams from Estonia and France in the Helsinki Cup. Corona guidelines are followed at the event.
## Finns' savings
![Money, banknotes.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11499084)
Open image viewer
During the corona times money has been saved. Photo: Ismo Pekkarinen / AOP
The savings of many Finns have grown during the corona times. Money has been saved, because, for example, foreign trips could not be made.
A Yle survey says that many do not intend to use their savings right after the corona times. Many Finns plan to invest their savings, for example in shares.
However, money is also going to be spent, for example on trips.
## Motorcycle collision
![Accident site in Kärkölä on 12 July 2021.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4032,h_2268,x_0,y_416/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-83100960ec168144dfe/1626085057)
Open image viewer
People have brought flowers to the accident site. Photo: Markku Heikkilä / Lehtikuva
A serious traffic accident has happened in Kärkölä. 3 people died when 2 motorcycles collided with each other.
In the accident the riders of both motorcycles and a passenger who was riding on the other motorcycle died.
The accident happened during the night between Sunday and Monday. The police are investigating the cause of the accident.
Kärkölä is a little under 100 kilometres from Helsinki.
## Drownings this summer

![Evening sun shines on the Hietaniemi beach in Helsinki.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4794,h_2697,x_155,y_603/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-83112960ec58e3678ec/1626102048)
Open image viewer
Hot weather encourages people onto the water. Photo: Roni Rekomaa / Lehtikuva
Many people have drowned over the weekend. The police say that at least 6 men and 1 woman drowned over the weekend.
During the whole early summer there have been many drownings. In June 30 people drowned.
## Hot weather
![weather map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12018491)
Open image viewer
Photo: Yle
Sunny summer weather continues.
In a large part of the country it is dry, that is, no rain falls. In Northern Lapland, however, there may be a few showers on Tuesday.
The temperature is between 25 and 30 degrees. In Lapland it is a little colder.
